fractals.title: Cantor Set Ladder
fractals.description: Triadic Cantor set formed by iteratively removing the open middle third from line segments.

fractals.title: Koch Snowflake
fractals.description: Continuous fractal boundary with infinite perimeter enclosing a finite planar area.

fractals.title: Sierpiński Triangle
fractals.description: Subdivision of equilateral triangle with central inverted cutout yielding a zero-measure area.

fractals.title: Sierpiński Carpet
fractals.description: Planar fractal obtained by cutting out the center sub-square from a 3x3 grid repeatedly.

fractals.title: Vicsek Box Fractal
fractals.description: Cross-type decomposition fractal keeping 5 of 9 equal sub-squares per iteration.

fractals.title: Pythagoras Tree
fractals.description: Harmonic branching fractal formed by erecting right triangles on top of recursive squares.

fractals.title: Heighway Dragon Curve
fractals.description: Paper-folding sequence turning 90° alternating left and right, tiling the plane without overlapping.

fractals.title: Hilbert Space-Filling Curve
fractals.description: Locality-preserving continuous fractal mapping a 1D line segment into the 2D unit square.

fractals.title: Fractal Binary Canopy
fractals.description: Harmonic botanical tree branching with Leonardo da Vinci thickness conservation: d² = d₁² + d₂².

fractals.title: Lévy C Curve
fractals.description: Isosceles right-triangle folding yielding an intricate self-similar coastal perimeter.

fractals.title: Barnsley Fern
fractals.description: Iterated Function System (IFS) affine transformations simulating natural biological self-similarity.

fractals.title: Gosper Curve (Flowsnake)
fractals.description: Hexagonal space-filling curve with non-trivial L-system rules, yielding a fractal boundary.

fractals.title: Mandelbrot Boundary Contours
fractals.description: Boundary isolines and escape contours of the quadratic complex iteration z_{n+1} = z_n² + c.

fractals.title: Julia Set (Douady's Rabbit)
fractals.description: Filled Julia set for c = -0.123 + 0.745i, exhibiting 3-fold rotational dendritic symmetry.

fractals.title: Newton-Raphson Basins
fractals.description: Julia boundary separating the basins of attraction for the cube roots of unity (z³ - 1 = 0).
